_comment: Cards the change list names that the meta DB genuinely cannot carry, each with the evidence that closed the question. check_patch_db.py reports these as ACCEPTED and does not fail on them, so a NEW gap still fails the gate instead of the tool being permanently red. Every entry needs a reason AND the evidence that established it - an entry with no evidence is a gap someone talked themselves out of. `seen_not_carried` holds the same kind of entry for cards NO change list names, found instead by the log pre-flight (logquery._unresolved_ids); logquery consults it so the pre-flight stops re-reporting a question that is already answered.

expected_missing.name: Sha of Fear
expected_missing.reason: no card id exists anywhere on this machine
expected_missing.evidence: 0 hearthstonejson entries by that exact name; the name appears in NO entityName of any of the 5 Power.log sessions on disk (scanned 2026-09-23 by pairing entityName= with cardId= on every TAG_CHANGE line - the method that DID find C'Thun's id, see below); absent from the 36.6.1 log-mined pool. It is the article's positional split point between the Aberration block and the other-tribes block, which is part of why its tribe is left null rather than inferred from position.

seen_not_carried.name: Gem Day
seen_not_carried.reason: the client card data carries no tier, and the log never puts it in a hand or a shop: it is game machinery, not a tavern spell the coach can price or buy
seen_not_carried.evidence: hearthstonejson has it as type SPELL (not BATTLEGROUND_SPELL), cost 0, no techLevel, no isBattlegroundsPoolSpell flag at all; in every one of the 1580 log lines naming it (5 sessions) it is created in zone=SETASIDE for player 7/8 and never enters HAND, PLAY or a shop; no TECH_LEVEL or COST tag is ever printed for it. tavern_spells.json feeds shop pricing and every entry must carry a curated read (tests/test_spells.py::test_all_spells_annotated), so carrying it means inventing a tier and an effect read for a card that can never appear in the shop. The pre-flight keeps reporting it until this entry exists - it is the 'genuine unknown' logquery._NON_CARD deliberately does not hide.

seen_not_carried.name: Blood Golem
seen_not_carried.reason: a trinket-SHAPED id that is not a trinket: it is the Golem token BG30_MagicItem_442 (Blood Golem Sticker) summons
seen_not_carried.evidence: the client card data gives it an empty description while every real trinket (and every Lesser/Greater `t` variant: BG36_MagicItem_403t, BG36_MagicItem_417t, BG30_MagicItem_914t, BG30_MagicItem_988t) carries text; its name differs from its base's ('Blood Golem' vs 'Blood Golem Sticker') where the Lesser/Greater pairs share a name; and no choice list ever offers it. Carrying it would put a token in the trinket pool, where choices.py ranks picks by trinket effects. tests/test_trinket_meta.py::test_every_trinket_seen_in_a_log_is_in_the_db consults this entry, so a NEW token-shaped id still fails the gate.

seen_not_carried.name: Aberrant Tentacle
seen_not_carried.reason: a summoned TOKEN with no card data anywhere on this machine, so the DB cannot carry it and it is not a pool minion
seen_not_carried.evidence: the 2026-09-23 late sessions render it (and its golden BGFYM_002t_G) as raw ids in the coach's own advice. The name comes from the log's own entityName pairing, and the patch article describes the source (Zoatroid: 'When you sell this, get a 0/2 Tentacle with Taunt'). It appears in NO hearthstonejson cache entry - neither the base BGFYM_002 nor BGFYM_002t exists there - so there is no text, tier or stats to add. Recorded rather than added to minions.json for the same reason as BG30_MagicItem_442t (Blood Golem): the DB is the POOL, and a summoned token in it could be mistaken for a purchasable card.

out_of_scope.reason: Duos-only cards; the coach coaches SOLO Battlegrounds
out_of_scope.evidence: Duos is a separate mode with its own card surface, and a Duos-only row in the solo DB could be recommended in a solo shop where it can never appear. The two changed Duos minions (Man'ari Messenger, Transport Reactor) are excluded for the same reason. Recorded here rather than silently dropped: Voidpriest Cloner's text ('Whenever you discard a card, Pass a copy of it. (2 times per turn.)') is the only published per-turn cap on discard triggers, and C'Thrax Wrecker's ('Give your team's Deities +4/+4') confirms Deity is a card type rather than one card - both were fed to the discard-engine work.

resolved.name: C'Thun
resolved.was: listed under expected_missing: 'no card id for the Battlegrounds card exists anywhere on this machine'
resolved.resolution: the id was in the logs the whole time. Pairing entityName= with cardId= on the TAG_CHANGE lines of the 2026-09-23 session yields entityName=C'Thun cardId=BGFYM_000 (1913 lines; its enchant is BGFYM_000e 'Eye See You'). The sibling Deity Y'Shaarj was already carried as BGFYM_011, and BGFYM_000 is not in the hearthstonejson cache at all - which is exactly why a cache-only (or name-only) search could never find it. Added to meta/minions.json (tier 3, 1/1, Aberration, cost 3) on 2026-09-23.

resolved.name: Greedy Conniver
resolved.was: listed under expected_missing: 'no card id exists anywhere on this machine'
resolved.resolution: the id arrived the moment a live game offered the card - BG36_369, read off an EntityChoices option in the 13:42 session on 2026-09-23 (entityName=Greedy Conniver id=5920 cardId=BG36_369), which the doctor pre-flight flagged as an unnamed id in the newest game. Added to meta/minions.json (tier 3, 7/7, Aberration, text from the patch article). This is the gap closing the way the entry predicted it would: not by a data source appearing, but by the card showing up in play.

resolved.name: Sewer Escapee
resolved.was: listed under expected_missing: 'no card id exists anywhere on this machine'
resolved.resolution: the 2026-09-23 scan ran against a stale .cards_full.json (35,807 entries, pre-36.6 carddefs missing). A 2026-09-24 re-download (36,022 entries) carries BG36_700 (Murloc, 4/5, tier 4, 'Activate (1): Give another Murloc +7/+7 and a random Bonus Keyword.'), and the 2026-09-24 session log confirms it in play: the Dark Discovery button (BG36_Button_DarkGift) summons it (entityName=Sewer Escapee cardId=BG36_700; its enchantment is BG36_700e 'Sewage Mutation'). Added to meta/minions.json via extend_pool.py --apply on 2026-09-24. Lesson: the patch-day gap scan is only as fresh as the carddefs cache it consults - refresh it on patch day.
